name: io.github.onexurOSS/manager-mcp
title: Onexur Manager MCP
description: MCP server for Manager.io bookkeeping: read-first with opt-in scoped task and write tools

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Manager API base URL (include /api2 when required)

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access token from Manager Settings (sent as X-API-KEY)

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated delete scopes (never implied by write scopes)

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (default) or http. This package entry always launches over stdio via uvx; set http only when running the server yourself as a standalone process, not via this registry launch.

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind host for HTTP transport. Defaults to loopback (127.0.0.1) when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Bind port for HTTP transport. Defaults to 8000 when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MANAGER_MCP_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token required of every HTTP request when set. HTTP transport has no authentication at all when this is unset -- see README's Transports section.
